scope: Volume VIII only; source checks, no freeze

groups.text: Use the defining identity for chain homotopy.
Use the cone differential and exact sequence.
Use coefficient chains and basic tensor identities.
Apply the UCT short exact sequence.
Apply the product chain complex or Künneth formula.
Use the definitions of cochains, coboundaries, and functoriality.
Use the cup-product laws and standard cohomology rings.
Use local triviality, transition functions, and clutching.

protected_mathematical_findings.title: 216 missing exercise statements
protected_mathematical_findings.explanation: VIII/22--VIII/30 each contain 24 exercise bodies consisting only of "Exercise N". They are not mathematical questions. The new hints are inferred from the preserved solutions, explicitly marked as solution-derived in the bank metadata; they cannot make those statements complete. An independently approved statement-restoration patch is required before a pedagogy release.

protected_mathematical_findings.title: Deck transformations: domain of a lift
protected_mathematical_findings.explanation: The solution calls deck transformations lifts of the identity. A deck transformation h:E->E satisfies p h=p: it is a lift of p through p, and lies over the identity of the base. A lift of id_X through p is instead a section X->E. The original solution is preserved.

protected_mathematical_findings.title: Free-word reduction stops too early
protected_mathematical_findings.explanation: The word a b a^{-1} a b^{-1} b reduces to a b. After the terminal b^{-1} b cancels, a^{-1} a still cancels. The assertion that no further inverse pair occurs is false. The original solution is preserved.

protected_mathematical_findings.title: Disk-pair connecting map at n=1
protected_mathematical_findings.explanation: The solution identifies both H_n(D^n,S^{n-1}) and H_{n-1}(S^{n-1}) with Z and calls the connecting map an isomorphism. This requires n>=2 in ordinary homology. For n=1 the target is H_0(S^0)=Z^2; the map has image the augmentation kernel. A reduced target also repairs the formulation.

protected_mathematical_findings.title: Reduced versus ordinary cone chains
protected_mathematical_findings.explanation: Any direct equivalence between ordinary singular chains of the topological cone and the algebraic cone needs a reduced/augmented convention or an explicit degree-zero adjustment. The algebraic cone of the identity is acyclic, while a nonempty contractible topological cone still has ordinary H_0=Z. The added hints state this distinction; the source exposition is not rewritten.

protected_mathematical_findings.location: Classification by clutching; Real line bundles over the circle
protected_mathematical_findings.title: Real clutching classification needs an equivalence convention
protected_mathematical_findings.explanation: The raw set [S^{n-1},O(k)] is not an unrestricted classification of unframed real bundles as written. At n=k=1, [S^0,O(1)] has four maps up to homotopy, whereas there are two real line bundles over S^1. Changes of hemisphere trivializations identify clutching data. Fix orientation/framing conventions or quotient by the appropriate changes of trivialization.

protected_mathematical_findings.title: Rank-one exception to the sphere obstruction formula
protected_mathematical_findings.explanation: The displayed primary obstruction formula using pi_{r-1}(S^{r-1})=Z requires r>=2 in this form. For rank one the sphere fiber is S^0 and the obstruction discussion is different; an oriented real line bundle is trivial. The new hint makes the rank restriction explicit without modifying the solution.
